answer: Each epoch, every identity receives a salted constraint task, a 14-line sonnet whose line initials encode its public key hash and whose end words must include sable and violet from a beacon seed. Verifiers check the acrostic in milliseconds, then cluster all poems by embedding distance and reject pairs closer than 0.2. Only identities passing 12 straight epochs earn payouts. A 10,000 identity swarm must write 120,000 distinct poems, costing roughly 4,800 USD in varied model calls and 144 hours of serial waiting. The gate behaves like a mint die that stamps every coin differently.
